headline: She waited decades for Scotland to make the World Cup. At 93, she'll cheer in person
context: Moira Brown, perhaps the oldest of Scotland's Tartan Army of soccer fans, will be in Boston when Scotland's team plays against Haiti on June 13. "I'm the luckiest person in this world," she says.
